items.source: Provides a convenient way to specify AbstractTemplateView's exposure flags for request attributes, session attributes, and Spring's macro helpers.
items.translation: 提供了一种方便的方式来指定 `AbstractTemplateView` 的请求属性、会话属性和 Spring 宏助手的暴露标志。

items.source: Subclasses will typically call super.buildView(viewName) first, before setting further properties themselves. loadView will then apply Spring lifecycle methods at the end of this process.
items.translation: 子类通常会首先调用 `super.buildView(viewName)`，然后再自行设置其他属性。`loadView` 随后将在该过程的末尾应用 Spring 生命周期方法。

items.source: Spring lifecycle methods as defined by the bean container do not have to be called here; those will be applied by the loadView method after this method returns.
items.translation: 由 Bean 容器定义的 Spring 生命周期方法不必在此处调用；这些方法将在本方法返回后，由 `loadView` 方法应用。

items.source:
Set whether all request attributes should be added to the
model prior to merging with the template. Default is "false".
items.translation: 设置是否应在与模板合并之前将所有请求属性添加到模型中。默认值为"false"。

items.source:
Set whether HttpServletRequest attributes are allowed to override (hide)
controller generated model attributes of the same name. Default is "false",
which causes an exception to be thrown if request attributes of the same
name as model attributes are found.
items.translation: 设置是否允许 `HttpServletRequest` 属性覆盖（隐藏）同名的控制器生成的模型属性。默认值为 `"false"`，如果找到与模型属性同名请求属性，将抛出异常。

items.source:
Set whether to expose a RequestContext for use by Spring's macro library,
under the name "springMacroRequestContext". Default is "true".
items.translation: 设置是否暴露 RequestContext 供 Spring 宏库使用，名称为"springMacroRequestContext"。默认值为"true"。
